Amazing cooking class with Ty at La Siesta hotel
Sep 2026 • Family
Ty was just amazing! She took us to the vegetable village and market in the morning, we went by bike! …Imagine the busy Vietnam traffic! Throughout the entire tour she was calm, professional, very friendly and her English language skills were perfect. We learned so much about the local herbs and farmers. In the afternoon the cooking class with Ty couldn’t be better. Everything we prepared was delicious and again Ty was very friendly, calm and professional. Our son (8 yrs old) was engaged the whole time, which says it all! Also grandma and mom had both a once in a lifetime experience. Thank you so much Ty! 🙏

EHG-Group
Dear Valued Guest,

Thank you so much for sharing such a wonderful and heartfelt review of your cooking experience with Ty!

We are delighted that your day became much more than just a cooking class—from cycling through Hoi An and visiting the local market and vegetable village to learning about the herbs, farmers, and ingredients that make Vietnamese cuisine so special.

Your words about Ty truly mean a lot to us. Her calmness, professionalism, friendliness, and ability to connect with guests are qualities we are very proud of, and we will make sure she personally receives your lovely compliments.

We especially smiled reading that your 8-year-old son stayed engaged throughout the entire experience! Knowing that three generations—grandma, mom, and son—could share such a memorable day together makes this review even more special. These are exactly the kinds of family memories we hope our cooking class can create.

Thank you again for choosing La Siesta Hoi An and, most importantly, for making Ty part of your family's Hoi An memories. We hope to welcome all of you back again one day for another unforgettable experience! 🙏
